The Immortal Cat doesn't quite remember how it survived. 
Once the smallest in its family, it was left alone after a fire that wiped them all out—an event too cruel to comprehend. 
It lost everything but gained a rare freedom spoken of only in legends. 
On nights haunted by nightmares, it lets out mournful, piercing cries, which have saved countless desert travelers from wild beasts as they dozed on the sands. 
Because of this, many believe it to be a guardian spirit, a savior. 
Survivors return time and again, hoping to touch the Immortal Cat. But it meets each approach with snarls, keeping all at bay. 
The more it withdraws, the stronger the throng that seeks its favor grows—a devoted following, worshipping it as their master. 
At times, the Immortal Cat wonders... are these so-called "servants" truly its family? 
Or could it be that its family has returned in a new form? 
It won't admit its need for them; instead, it keeps howling through the night— 
though perhaps now, the cries come from something deeper than just nightmares.
